name: fitted_offset_tolerance
description: How large may a whole-run too-far offset be before HiDrive's TASC car-car cases that are safe without error start to crash, and where do the cars of the K-Radar log fall? Every target keeps offset_m for the whole run (fitted, offset fixed), as ASF's car read 2.26 m too far from 49 m down to 11 m; offset_only has no random part (deterministic, one seed), offset_noise adds the spread around each car's mean of PV-RCNN++ (0.12 m under 25 m) or ASF (0.32 m), 5 seeds. Misses off; lost target as in fitted_profiles. 9800 runs.
